metadata.title: Secure Print Release

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring printed output is physically released only to the authorized requester at the point of printing.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Secure print queues, pull-print systems, release stations, identity-aware printers, and print job holding mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for preventing unattended or misdirected print output through identity-bound release controls.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure print release assumes baseline print identity attribution and accountability.

metadata.remarks: Secure Print Release defines trust properties required to prevent walk-up disclosure and misdelivery of printed materials. This pattern ensures that print jobs remain held until explicitly released by an authenticated and authorized individual at the output device.

components.title: Print Job Hold and Controlled Release
components.description: Ensures print jobs are not output until explicitly released by the intended recipient.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection of sensitive information from unattended print output.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Data access control to prevent unauthorized retrieval of printed artifacts.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Print jobs containing sensitive information are protected to prevent unauthorized access.

components.title: Identity-Bound Release Authentication
components.description: Requires user authentication at the printer or release station before output is produced.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid credentials to retrieve another user's output.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading to falsely claim ownership of a print job.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong authentication to bind release actions to an identity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Print release requires authentication of the requesting individual.
Identity attributes support accurate association of print jobs with users.

components.title: Print Release Context and Device Binding
components.description: Constrains print job release to approved devices and physical contexts.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Misuse of trusted physical access to intercept printed materials.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Access control to restrict where print jobs may be released.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Print release privileges are restricted by device and context.

components.title: Secure Print Release Auditability
components.description: Provides traceability of print release actions for accountability and investigation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression or avoidance of evidence related to print output misuse.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging to support attribution and misuse investigation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Print release events are defined and logged.
Audit review supports detection of unauthorized or suspicious print release.
